node.statement: Associating only as explicitly displayed and using ordinary matrix multiplication, (Y^dagger dot Z) dot X=sum_{i,j}(Y_i^dagger dot Z_ij) dot X_j, whereas Y^dagger dot (Z dot X)=sum_{i,j}Y_i^dagger dot (Z_ij dot X_j); hence their difference is sum_{i,j}((Y_i^dagger dot Z_ij) dot X_j-Y_i^dagger dot (Z_ij dot X_j)).
